The desired solution is an integrated suite of swarm-replication software, target-control networks, and multi-sensor tracking algorithms designed to evaluate defensive weapon systems against high-density autonomous threats. The solution should deliver: • Swarm Replication & C2: An advanced, highly scalable target command and control system capable of orchestrating and simulating the coordinated tactics of large-scale (50+ units) autonomous drone swarms. • Passive Multi-Sensor Fusion: Advanced tracking algorithms capable of fusing passive optical and radar sensor data to reliably track low-signature swarms in GPS-denied and RF-contested environments. • High-Density TSPI: Miniaturized, high-precision Time-Space-Position Information (TSPI) instrumentation suitable for deployment on small, low-cost target drones to capture precise intercept trajectories. 3 • Realistic Threat Behaviors: Software-defined threat profiles that can adapt and react dynamically to defensive actions, replacing static, predictable target paths with representative adversary tactics. 4. The desired solution is an integrated suite of swarm-replication software, target-control networks, and multi-sensor tracking algorithms designed to evaluate defensive weapon systems against high-density autonomous threats. The solution should deliver: • Swarm Replication & C2: An advanced, highly scalable target command and control system capable of orchestrating and simulating the coordinated tactics of large-scale (50+ units) autonomous drone swarms. • Passive Multi-Sensor Fusion: Advanced tracking algorithms capable of fusing passive optical and radar sensor data to reliably track low-signature swarms in GPS-denied and RF-contested environments. • High-Density TSPI: Miniaturized, high-precision Time-Space-Position Information (TSPI) instrumentation suitable for deployment on small, low-cost target drones to capture precise intercept trajectories. 3 • Realistic Threat Behaviors: Software-defined threat profiles that can adapt and react dynamically to defensive actions, replacing static, predictable target paths with representative adversary tactics. 4.
